gaps.sentence: We saw our guests ___ at the station.
gaps.explanation: see somebody off = go with a traveller to say goodbye.

gaps.sentence: The protesters set ___ at dawn from the village square.
gaps.explanation: set off/out = begin a journey; set up = establish.

gaps.sentence: He ended ___ selling insurance, though he'd trained as a chef.
gaps.explanation: end up = finally be in a place/situation/state.

gaps.sentence: They get ___ on very little money.
gaps.explanation: get by = manage to survive (with difficulty).

gaps.sentence: Don't leave ___ any details in your report.
Prices levelled ___ after the crazy spring market.
gaps.explanation: level off = stop rising or falling and stay the same.

gaps.sentence: The new law will phase ___ disposable plastics by 2030.
gaps.explanation: phase out = gradually stop using something.

gaps.sentence: The two founders hit it ___ immediately.
gaps.explanation: hit it off = like each other and become friendly quickly.
